headline: Gəncə urban district analysis with regional indicators

tags.reason: There are 0.97 universities per 10,000 residents, compared to the national median of 0.03.
Healthcare facilities include 1.30 hospitals per 10,000 residents, exceeding the national median of 0.75.

summary: Gəncə has a population density of 3,010 residents per square kilometre across an area of 181.6 square kilometres. New apartments are priced at AZN 1,020/m² on an estimate basis, while old apartments cost AZN 680/m². The district registers an infrastructure index of 75 and a transport index of 76. Paved roads account for 27.7% of the known road network surface of 1,182 km.
strengths: Education index stands at 79, backed by 3.87 schools per 10,000 residents (national median 4.14).
Transport index reaches 76, supported by 53 bus stops and 1 rail stations (neqliyyat index 76, national median 47).
Convenience index is 66, featuring 2.78 groceries per 10,000 residents (national median 2.29).
weaknesses: Road surface data shows only 27.7% paved roads of known surfaces, with 64.7% surface unknown (paved share 27.7%, national median 4.35%).
Nature index is registered at 41, with forest landcover standing at 1.3% (tebiet index 41, national median 51).
Affordability index elcatanliq is 44, which is lower than the national median of 50.
best_for: Buyers seeking established educational institutions with 0.97 universities per 10,000 residents.
Residents requiring healthcare access with 1.30 hospitals per 10,000 residents.
watch_out: Surface unknown percentage is 64.7% for the 1,182 km road network.
Heyet evi price of AZN 600/m² and obyekt price of AZN 1,100/m² use mock confidence.
confidence_note: OSM coverage is high. Price confidence is estimate for apartments and mock for houses, plots, and commercial properties.
